notes: Authoritative registry of every content family the Portfolio Collection PDF pipeline can emit. Mirrors src/lib/publishing/publishSourceRegistry.json's role for the publishing pipeline. Read by scripts/pdf-export-preflight-lib.mjs and scripts/pdf-export-postflight-lib.mjs. See docs/PDF_EXPORT_ARCHITECTURE.md for the human-readable version of every field below.
canonicalRendererInvariant: Project rendering has one canonical source: exact-web export. Collection PDF assembles canonical project output and must not maintain an independent project rendering pipeline. See docs/PDF_EXPORT_ARCHITECTURE.md.

captureProjectPage.role: Shared Collection orchestrator: navigates to the canonical project DOM, audits content/media, delegates project-content printing to renderExactWebPdf, then composes one independent Collection page-chrome layer below that content. It never selects alternate PDFs or project-specific DOM.

renderExactWebPdf.domSnapshotBuiltBy: buildExactSnapshotResult, src/components/ProjectExactWebExportAction.tsx (exposed dev-only on window.__exactWebExport for captureProjectPage to call)

modes.continuous: single page sized to exact measured content height, used when height <= 7100px
modes.section-pages: splits into real top-level-section physical pages, used above the continuous-mode threshold

renderExactWebPdf.note: The single renderer for project CONTENT in both single-project export and Collection. PROJECT END, summary, selected-order indicator and Back to Index are not inserted into this DOM; Collection adds them afterward as one shared page-level chrome layer.

collectionPageChrome.sizing: content-measured height layer appended to each variable-height project page — never a fixed constant
collectionPageChrome.heightPx: measured per-project from the chrome's own real rendered content (label + summary, however many lines it wraps to, + back-link) via renderCollectionPageChrome's two-pass measure-then-print; a wrapping summary grows the chrome naturally instead of being clipped
collectionPageChrome.note: Independent PDF page furniture only. It spans page-level safe margins, carries PROJECT END / canonical summary / selected-order indicator / Back to Index, and never participates in project DOM measurement. finalMarginPx (the small bottom safe area) is tracked separately from heightPx (the footer's own measured content height) and is the only value in this geometry still a stable fixed constant.

unifyCollectionPageWidths.role: Final merge-stage-only canvas framing that enforces the Collection page geometry HARD INVARIANT: every physical page in the merged PDF ends at one identical MediaBox width (targetWidth = max(actual width of every page in this export), computed fresh per export — never a fixed constant like 1440). Runs once in mergeCollection, after every source page is already copied in and after addLinkAnnotations/addBackToIndexAnnotations have added their annotations. Never scales content and never touches project capture width/viewport — a narrower page's MediaBox is extended (page.setSize) and its already-rendered content stream is re-centered (page.translateContent), the same pattern collectionPageChrome already uses to extend page height. A page already at targetWidth is left completely untouched.
unifyCollectionPageWidths.fullBleedHandling: Structural, not template/project-ID-based. src/components/ProjectExactWebExportAction.tsx's markFullBleedRegions tags any snapshot-clone element whose rendered rect reaches both viewport edges with a real painted background-color; scripts/exactWebExportPlugin.ts's measureFullBleedRegions records each one's Y-range and computed color at final layout; applyCollectionPageChrome converts those into this page's own final PDF-point space. unifyCollectionPageWidths extends that exact flat color (alpha-composited against the page base color #181743) into the new left/right strips for that Y-range, so a full-bleed element (e.g. PhaseMilestonesTemplate.tsx) keeps touching both new edges. Only a solid background-color with no background-image/gradient/backdrop-filter is losslessly extendable (safe: true); anything else is recorded per-page as fullBleedUnsafeSkipped and left with the plain page background — never silently approximated — for postflight's FULL_BLEED_REGION_NOT_LOSSLESSLY_EXTENDED warning to surface for a human decision.

sharedGeometry.note: 1440px is the authored baseline for Cover and index, not a permanent final output width. captureCoverPage passes the export's final target physical width into collectionCoverRenderer, which scales every coordinate, graphic, font, image, gap, footer and TOC nav rectangle together before PDF embedding. Project pages remain unscaled and may only receive MediaBox expansion plus centering.

knownEngineQuirks.description: Playwright's page.pdf() always evaluates @media print rules in the loaded stylesheet, regardless of any prior page.emulateMedia({ media: 'screen' }) call. emulateMedia only affects on-screen page.evaluate()-based measurement, never what page.pdf() itself resolves stylesheet media queries against.
knownEngineQuirks.implication: Any @media print rule anywhere in src/styles.css is live for every page.pdf() call in this pipeline (captureProjectPage, renderSectionPdf, captureCoverPage), independent of which attribute or query param a rule appears to be scoped by.
knownEngineQuirks.mitigation: preferCSSPageSize: false is set on every page.pdf() call in scripts/portfolioCollectionExportPlugin.ts to defeat unscoped @page rules. Any new @media print rule must be audited against every renderer above, not just the feature that motivated it.

knownEngineQuirks.description: src/styles.css defines @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 8mm; } inside the same @media print block as scoped print rules. @page cannot be attribute-scoped by definition, so it applies to every page.pdf() call unconditionally.
knownEngineQuirks.implication: This rule is currently inert only because preferCSSPageSize is explicitly set to false on every call site. If a future call site omits that option, page geometry silently reverts to A4 portrait with 8mm margins instead of the pipeline's real 1440x900 / segment-height geometry.
knownEngineQuirks.status: known, not yet fixed as of 2026-08-07 — tracked in TASKS.md, deferred pending re-investigation of the figure/table/img blank-segment symptom through this registry rather than as an isolated patch
